keeperRemainingCap(address).details: The previous 30-day keeper limiter has been removed because the repository      contains no independent economic rate-limit parameter. Keeper withdrawals      are now limited only by keeperReserve[token].

params.maxTraderPayable: The hook's RAW physical cap. Under Model A custody the        hook has NOT yet transferred this event's funds to the vault, so the        hook's _realBackingRaw cap is the SOLE authority.
params.token: The PAYOUT currency (raw units) — the swap's OUTPUT currency,        which may be currency0 OR currency1.

returns.traderRebate: Final immediately-payable rebate (≤ maxTraderPayable),                         raw payout-currency units. Never deferred.

reservedObligations(address).details: protocolRevenue is intentionally NOT reserved: it is a withdrawal right      gated against surplus at withdrawal time. Both residue buckets ARE reserved.

setLpEpochThresholdDirect(address,uint25.details: This does not enable settleLpEpoch or change indexed LP funding/claims.

settleLpEpoch(bytes32,address).details: Indexed LP rewards are funded in finalizeRealizationLp; users claim      from the adapter ledger. No keeper donation is required.

unlockCallback(bytes).details: The disabled settleLpEpoch entry point no longer initiates an unlock.

withdrawKeeperFunds(address,address,uint.details: Limited only by keeperReserve[token] (the 30-day limiter was removed).

cappedTraderRemainder(address).notice: Trader rebate that physical backing could not cover (capTrader). An         operational under-backing signal. Fully reserved. Economic ownership         intentionally unresolved pending a future governance-approved policy.

lpEpochThreshold(address).notice: Legacy per-token LP threshold retained for storage/ABI compatibility.

lpPendingByToken(bytes32,address).notice: Phase 3C: LP obligations are TOKEN-SPECIFIC. A USDC obligation is         NEVER interchangeable with a WETH one.

onRecapture(bytes32,address,address,addr.notice: Report realized corrective recapture; receive the trader rebate         the hook must pay in-swap via afterSwapReturnDelta.

registerPool(bytes32,(address,address,ui.notice: Register a pool; verifies keccak256(abi.encode(key)) == poolId.

reservedObligations(address).notice: Reserved obligations that protocol withdrawals may never touch.

roundingDust(address).notice: Integer-division residue from the 5-way split (≤4 units/event). No         identifiable economic owner. Fully reserved.

setLpEpochThresholdDirect(address,uint25.notice: Update a legacy compatibility field through the existing timelock.

setRouterRegistered(address,bool).notice: Immediate governance (justified: enables only future accrual,         cannot touch existing balances; integration speed matters).

settleLpEpoch(bytes32,address).notice: Legacy LP epoch settlement is disabled for every caller and threshold.

unlockCallback(bytes).notice: Retained legacy callback, restricted to the immutable PoolManager.

vault().notice: Physical custody vault used for non-trader economics.
